title: Indian Cars Dataset
subtitle: Prices, specifications and features for new cars sold in India
description:
New car models, variants and specifications from the Indian market.

Each row is a single trim of a single model: its price, engine, transmission,
fuel type, mileage and a set of features. Both currently sold and discontinued
models are included, flagged by the `Discontinued` column.

## Important: read `Price_Type` before comparing prices

Prices come in two kinds and they are **not** interchangeable:

- `ex-showroom` -- the base price
- `on-road` -- includes registration, insurance and road tax, typically
  15-25% higher

Some models only publish one or the other. Filter on `Price_Type` before any
budget-based comparison or model training, or the price signal will be noisy.

## Other notes

- `Price` is in Indian rupees. Where the source gave a range, the midpoint is
  stored.
- Discontinued models usually have no listed price, so `Price` is blank for
  many of them.
- `Mileage` is kmpl and is often blank for electric vehicles, which are quoted
  in range rather than fuel efficiency.
- Feature columns are `Yes` / `no`, derived from whether the feature appears in
  the published specification for that trim. They reflect what the source
  publishes, which is occasionally wrong for older discontinued models.
- `Combined Description` concatenates the row into a single text field for
  embedding or semantic search.

Collected automatically each month.

resources.description: One row per car variant: price, engine, transmission, fuel, mileage and features.

fields.name: Brand
fields.description: Manufacturer, e.g. Maruti Suzuki, Tata, BMW.

fields.name: Car
fields.description: Model name, e.g. Nexon, Carens Clavis, DB11.

fields.name: Variant
fields.description: Trim level within the model, e.g. Creative Plus, HTX, Boxster GTS.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Generated summary of the variant's fuel, transmission, price, engine, mileage and notable features.

fields.name: Price
fields.description: Price in Indian rupees. Ranges are stored as their midpoint. Read alongside Price_Type.

fields.name: Price_Type
fields.description: Whether Price is 'ex-showroom' or 'on-road'. These are NOT comparable -- on-road includes registration and insurance and runs 15-25% higher. Filter on this before any budget comparison.

fields.name: Discontinued
fields.description: 'Yes' if the model is superseded or no longer sold. Discontinued cars usually have no listed price.

fields.name: Fuel Type
fields.description: Petrol, Diesel, CNG, Electric, LPG or Hybrid.

fields.name: Mileage
fields.description: Fuel efficiency in kmpl. Often blank for electric cars, which quote range instead.

fields.name: Transmission
fields.description: Gearbox description, e.g. 'Manual - 5 Gears', 'Automatic (DCT) - 7 Gears'.

fields.name: Engine
fields.description: Raw engine string as published, e.g. '1199 cc, 3 Cylinders Inline, 4 Valves/Cylinder, DOHC'. Split into the five columns that follow.

fields.name: Displacement (cc)
fields.description: Engine displacement in cc, parsed from Engine.

fields.name: Cylinders
fields.description: Number of cylinders, parsed from Engine.

fields.name: Cylinder Layout
fields.description: Cylinder arrangement: Inline, V, W, Flat.

fields.name: Valves per Cylinder
fields.description: Valves per cylinder, parsed from Engine.

fields.name: Valve Train
fields.description: Valve train type: DOHC, SOHC, OHV.

fields.name: Cluster Type
fields.description: Instrument cluster technology: Analogue, Digital, Analogue - Digital, TFT.

fields.name: Cluster Size
fields.description: Cluster screen size where stated, e.g. '12.3-inch'. Most cars do not publish this.

fields.name: Heads Up Display
fields.description: Whether a HUD is fitted: Yes, Optional or no.

fields.name: Tachometer
fields.description: Tachometer type: Analogue or Digital.

fields.name: Display
fields.description: Infotainment display description.

fields.name: Sunroof / Moonroof
fields.description: Yes if a sunroof or moonroof is listed.

fields.name: Dashcam
fields.description: Yes if a dashcam is listed.

fields.name: Rear AC
fields.description: Yes if rear air conditioning is listed.

fields.name: Central Locking
fields.description: Yes if central locking is listed.

fields.name: Cruise Control
fields.description: Yes if cruise control is listed.

fields.name: Hill Hold Control
fields.description: Yes if hill hold control is listed.

fields.name: Ventilated Seats
fields.description: Yes if ventilated seats are listed.

fields.name: Wireless Charger
fields.description: Yes if wireless phone charging is listed.

fields.name: Adjustable ORVMs
fields.description: Yes if adjustable outside mirrors are listed.

fields.name: Integrated (in-dash) Music System
fields.description: Yes if an in-dash music or infotainment system is listed.

fields.name: Speakers
fields.description: Yes if speakers are listed.

fields.name: Instrument Cluster
fields.description: Raw instrument cluster feature list, source for the Cluster columns above.

fields.name: Combined Description
fields.description: All fields concatenated into one text blob, intended for embedding / semantic search.

fields.name: Meta_Description
fields.description: The site's original SEO meta description. Mostly boilerplate; kept for reference.
